prompt: Night, a 1920s city street after rain, a 16:9 picture filling the frame edge to edge. A money truck job at speed: an open black touring car runs alongside an armoured truck. A 35mm lens rides on the touring car's folded-down windscreen, looking back at a stubbled man of about sixty-five with a broad, scarred face and a grey felt hat, standing in the rear seat, chest-up and large in frame, turned near-frontal, mouth open mid-word. Canvas money bags split around his feet and banknotes whirl in an emerald beam from a tinted headlamp. Gold bulbs strung over the road light his mouth and jaw. The truck's lacquered flank fills the frame behind him, mirroring those gold bulbs as a sliding row of points. Thanks.
